name: Omochazuma
source:
Please ... do not stop! !  
The innocent virgin wife turns into a sexual slave. No matter how much bullying continues, Saya remains loyal. Is she a nymphomaniac or is there a line that can not be crossed?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
求你了……不要停！
天真纯洁、尚未经历初夜的妻子，逐渐变成了性奴。无论遭受多少欺凌，Saya始终忠心不改。她是色情狂，还是仍有一条不可逾越的底线？
